what: The bundled commands of the Mac app: each button writes its command into the command line (the state's "request"); the state is read from this Mac ("Open the demo's devices" opens the TV app, Calculator and both drafts, plays the music and sets the volume to 25, so every command has something to act on). "take" lists the commands of the recorded scene, in order. The same commands, each with a fixed state and the answers written down before the model ran, are eval/dev.json.

commands.title: Quit every app but TV
commands.request: Quit every app except the TV app, and keep the music playing.

commands.title: At 10:15 tonight
commands.request: At 10:15 tonight, quit the TV app.

commands.title: Work group but Calculator
commands.request: Close the work group, but keep the calculator as it is.

commands.title: Apps over 300 MB
commands.request: Quit the apps using more than 300 MB of memory.

commands.title: Whenever music plays
commands.request: Whenever the music starts playing, set the volume to 30%.
